# John Solly

> Personal website of John Solly — CTO of Enterprise Health at Leidos Digital, software engineer, and builder of spatial + AI systems. Static site; no product API.

This file is the index for agents. Prefer it over scraping HTML. Every published portfolio, blog and recipe page supports Markdown. Browser controls remain on the HTML page. Send `Accept: text/markdown` (acceptmarkdown.com), or fetch a `.md` sibling: `/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md`, `/terms.md`, `/blog.md`, `/blog/all-posts.md`, `/recipes.md` and `/recipes/works-cited.md`. A post or recipe at `/blog/slug/` or `/recipes/slug/` has a sibling at `/blog/slug.md` or `/recipes/slug.md`.

## Search

This site has a search endpoint: https://context7.com/api/v2/ask?siteKey=ask_43369889032b1355b89bc7f4&query=<URL-encoded question>. It returns documentation that answers the question, with a source link for each part. No API key is needed. If nothing matches, it says so.

## When to use this

Use jsolly.com when you need:

- A short, canonical bio for **John Solly** (CTO, Enterprise Health, Leidos Digital; spatial systems / GIS; applied AI in federal health and benefits)
- How to **contact** him (form + public profiles) — not a Leidos switchboard
- His **blog**: articles about geospatial development, web development, AI and productivity, with RSS and Atom feeds
- His **recipes**: easy meals and smoothies, with serving scaling and appliance filters
- Links to his **resume** and **GitHub**
- Privacy / data-handling facts for this personal site
- Terms for using and reusing this site's original content

Do **not** use this site when you need:

- Official **Leidos** corporate, careers, or contract information — use [leidos.com](https://www.leidos.com/)
- A public HTTP API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, OAuth, webhooks, or a SaaS product — this origin has none

How to fetch:

1. Read this file.
2. For a page, GET its URL with `Accept: text/markdown`, or GET the `.md` sibling. Markdown preserves article links, anchors and complex authored HTML. Recipe Markdown uses the canonical four servings in US measures and retains source and nutrition disclosures; query parameters do not change it. Use HTML for search, pagination, servings and other browser controls.
3. For a missing page path (no file extension) or `.md` sibling, expect HTTP 404 with a Markdown recovery body (sitemap, this file, contact); a missing file returns the site's HTML 404.
4. To reach John, use [Contact](https://www.jsolly.com/contact/) — there is no public email published here.

## Recipe data

- [Complete recipe library (JSON)](https://www.jsolly.com/recipes/data/recipe-library.json): schemaVersion 2; find a recipe by its stable `recipeId`. Includes measured ingredients, cooking steps and dependency flow, equipment, allergens, source attribution and nutrition assumptions.
- [Complete recipe library (Markdown)](https://www.jsolly.com/recipes/data/recipe-library.md): the same recipes as readable text. For one recipe, prefer its smaller `/recipes/<recipe-id>.md` document, advertised by the HTML page's `rel="alternate"` link.
- Static documents use four servings in US measures and no optional side. URL query parameters do not scale these documents. Use each recipe's recorded portion label; smoothies report nutrition per estimated 8 fl oz (237 mL) glass.
- Keto means at most 12.5 g net carbohydrates per base serving. Optional sides have separate per-person nutrition and do not change the base classification. Nutrition is estimated from reviewed ingredient profiles; preserve the source, brand-proxy and preparation limitations when answering.
- Human recipe pages keep data access in head metadata rather than download controls. No authentication or browser interaction is needed to read these files.
